title: Toward Scalable Audio Description Quality Control: A Workflow for Evaluating Human and VLM Raters
abstract: arXiv:2602.01390v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Digital video is central to communication, education, and entertainment, but without audio description (AD), blind and low-vision users are excluded. While crowdsourced platforms and vision-language models (VLMs) expand AD production, quality is rarely checked systematically. Existing evaluations rely on NLP metrics and short-clip guidelines, leaving open the question of how to assess long-form AD quality at scale. Evaluations were based on a six-dimensional framework, grounded in professional guidelines and shaped by insights from our accessibility experts and blind consultants. translated_title: 迈向可扩展的音频描述质量控制：一种评估人类与视觉语言模型评分者的工作流程
translated_abstract: 数字视频是沟通、教育和娱乐的核心，但如果没有音频描述（AD），盲人和低视力用户就会被排除在外。尽管众包平台和视觉语言模型（VLM）扩展了音频描述的制作规模，但其质量却很少得到系统性检查。现有评估依赖于自然语言处理（NLP）指标和短片段指南，这使得如何大规模评估长篇音频描述质量的问题仍然悬而未决。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种方法论工作流程，利用项目反应理论（IRT）来评估VLM和人类评分者相对于专家建立的基准真值的评分能力。评估基于一个六维框架，该框架以专业指南为基础，并融合了我们的无障碍专家和盲人顾问的见解。研究结果表明，表现最好的VLM能够在与人类评分者相当的水平上逼近基准真值评分。然而，定性分析显示，VLM的推理可靠性较低（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于项目反应理论（IRT）并结合六维评估框架的方法论工作流程，用于系统性评估视觉语言模型与人类评分者在音频描述质量控制中的能力，发现顶级VLM可达到与人类评分者相当的评分水平。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Item Response Theory-based methodological workflow with a six-dimensional evaluation framework to systematically assess the proficiency of VLM and human raters in audio description quality control, finding that top-performing VLMs can approximate ground-truth ratings at levels comparable to human raters.
